name: Should I choose a shower-only or a tub-shower combination for a rental property?

mainEntity.name: Should I choose a shower-only or a tub-shower combination for a rental property?

acceptedAnswer.text: The best choice between a shower-only or tub-shower combination often depends on your target tenant demographic and the property type. For family-oriented rentals, a tub-shower combination is often preferred as it caters to families with young children. In smaller units or properties targeting single professionals, a spacious shower-only can be a more modern and space-efficient option. Consider the typical preferences in your local rental market.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a tub-shower combination for family rentals and a shower-only for smaller units or professional tenants. Consider your target demographic and local market preferences.
